The '''Belbullab-24 strike bomber''', also known as the '''CIS Strike Bomber''', was a [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] variant of the [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] that saw action during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later. The fighter was equipped with [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].

==History==
The Belbullab-24 were used by some of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], including [[Gizor Dellso]]'s faction on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. While [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|battling]] Dellso's forces over Mustafar, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] requested that an [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] retrieve a Belbullab-24 and to deliver it to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces for closer inspection.
